thig6.1:1.1:
[Paṭācārā recounts the Buddha’s words:]
“You don’t know
the path
thig6.1:1.3:
that being who has come
from where?—
thig6.1:1.4: the one you lament as ‘my son.’
thig6.1:2.1:
But when you know
the path
thig6.1:2.4:
for that is the nature
of beings.
thig6.1:3.2:
Without permission,
he went from here
thig6.1:3.5: And coming one way from here,
thig6.1:3.6:
he goes yet another
from there.
thig6.1:4.3: As he came, so he has gone—
thig6.1:4.4:
so what is there
to lament?”
thig6.1:5.2:
the arrow so hard to see,
embedded in my heart,
thig6.1:5.3:
he [the Buddha] expelled from me
—overcome with grief—
thig6.1:6.3: to the Buddha, Dhamma, & Saṅgha I go,
